brief: Customer feedback stack — 6 tools that close the loop between user and PR.

slots.tagline: Airtable turns scattered user opinions into a structured, filterable database the whole team trusts.
slots.f1Body: Embed branded forms anywhere to collect feature requests without writing code.
slots.f2Body: Connect feedback to users and priorities so context never disappears.
slots.f3Body: Switch between kanban, gallery, and grid to spot patterns instantly.

slots.tagline: Make silently moves feedback from forms to docs to trackers while your team stays focused.
slots.f1Body: Build no-code automations that parse and route every incoming request.
slots.f2Body: Link Airtable, Notion, and Linear in minutes without custom code.
slots.f3Body: Built-in logs show exactly where data stops so you fix it fast.

slots.tagline: Notion becomes the single source of truth for roadmaps, PRDs, and release notes.
slots.f1Body: Organize product briefs and user research in one collaborative workspace.
slots.f2Body: Link PRDs directly to feedback tickets so rationale stays visible.
slots.f3Body: Share public roadmaps that keep users informed about what ships next.

slots.tagline: Figma turns validated feedback into interactive prototypes before a single line of code.
slots.f1Body: Designers and PMs comment in real time to iterate faster together.
slots.f2Body: Inspect mode gives engineers specs, assets, and CSS without extra tools.
slots.f3Body: Run clickable user tests to confirm the solution solves the real pain.

slots.tagline: Linear keeps engineering aligned with product so feedback becomes released features on schedule.
slots.f1Body: Fly through issues with command-line speed and zero friction workflows.
slots.f2Body: Branches and pull requests sync automatically to keep status honest.
slots.f3Body: Time-boxed sprints ensure the highest impact feedback ships every week.

slots.tagline: Loom sends personal video updates to users the moment their requested feature goes live.
slots.f1Body: Capture your screen and voice in one click to explain new releases.
slots.f2Body: See who watched and reacted so you know the message landed.
slots.f3Body: Replace live demos with reusable videos that answer questions before they ask.

slots.ctaBody: Steal this exact stack to turn user voices into shipped features your customers love.
